title: Exact integer total decision
software_contract: has_total(values, target) returns exactly whether some subset of list positions has sum equal to target. Each position is usable at most once; equal values at different positions are distinct available elements. Empty subset is allowed, so target zero is always true. No witness is returned and input is not mutated. Only valid-domain behavior is specified; no new validation requirement is added to the source function.
input_domain: Finite list of Python integers (not bool), and target a Python integer (not bool). Signed values and targets are permitted. No imposed length or numeric cap. The paired inventory context uses a documented nonnegative business subdomain and filters held/site-ineligible entries; it is not claimed to expose the entire signed core domain.
execution_assumptions: Ordinary classical data. No workload distribution, hardware or resource-cost evidence is provided.
